payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a comparison dashboard. Use: side-by-side metrics, period selectors (vs last month), delta indicators (+/-), benchmark lines, A/B comparison tables, winning/losing highlights, percentage change badges.
payload.best_for: Period-over-period reporting, A/B test dashboards, market comparison, competitive analysis, regional performance
payload.css_technical_keywords: display: flex for side-by-side, gap for comparison spacing, color coding (green up, red down), arrow indicators, diff highlighting, comparison table zebra striping
payload.do_not_use_for: Single metric dashboards, future projections (use forecasting), real-time only (no historical)
payload.effects_and_animation: Comparison bar animations (grow to value), delta indicator animations (direction arrows), highlight on compare
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Period selector works, ☐ Deltas calculated, ☐ Colors meaningful, ☐ Benchmarks shown, ☐ Mobile stacks properly, ☐ Export comparison
payload.keywords: Side-by-side comparisons, period-over-period metrics, A/B test results, regional comparisons, performance benchmarks
payload.primary_colors: Comparison colors: primary (blue), comparison (orange/purple), delta indicator (green/red)
payload.secondary_colors: Winning metric color (green), losing metric color (red), neutral comparison (grey), benchmark colors
